note: Measured token costs of agent runs, in thousands of tokens (tokens_k = [low, high]; one figure with no spread has low equal to high). Each row is one measured use of one agent type, dated, with the run it came from. fleet-plan prints a row for the calls of its agent in its workflow and says 'not measured' for every other call: a figure from one use is not a measurement of another. A row with workflow null is a main-thread fleet that has no workflow to plan; the fleet gate states its figure from here. Add a row only from a measured run, never from an estimate.
